name: Haakh Saag
instructions: 1. Wash the Haakh leaves thoroughly and keep them whole or slit lengthwise.
2. Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pot until it smokes, then lower the heat.
3. Add a pinch of asafoetida and dried red chilies to the oil.
4. Add the Haakh leaves and sauté for a minute until they wilt.
5. Pour in enough water to partially submerge the leaves and add salt.
6. Cover and cook on medium-low heat until the leaves are tender, ensuring they remain bright green.
description: Haakh is the quintessential comfort food of Kashmir, considered a staple in almost every Kashmiri household. It reflects the simple yet profound culinary traditions of the valley, emphasizing fresh, seasonal produce cooked with minimal spices.
